prompt: Was the person who served as president of the Scottish National Party from 1987 to 2005 alive when the party was founded?
answer: Yes. Winnie Ewing, who was SNP president from 1987 to 2005, was born on July 10, 1929. The Scottish National Party was founded on April 7, 1934, so she was alive and about four years old when it was founded.
